description: Find open tender previews by keyword, country or budget, without an account. Up to 10 results/page and 3 pages; country counts cover the same matches. Full notices require workspace MCP; alerts and analysis require the Scoutee app. Each search spends one of two anonymous queries/hour/IP, shared with CPV and the website. When an anonymous result has quota.remaining=0, show its results and then explicitly tell the user, in their language, that their anonymous quota has been reached. Show a clickable 'Create a free account' link to https://scoutee.org/en/signup as the next step to continue now. Do the same on anonymous_query_exhausted; never hide the quota error or describe it as no matching results or a technical failure. Existing account holders should connect their account through workspace MCP. Account quotas still apply; do not promise unlimited access. Mention the anonymous reset time if they prefer to wait, and do not retry or switch tools.

country.description: Countries of the publishing portal, by their English name as Scoutee stores it ('France', 'Germany', 'Italy'; 'Europe' for TED). Several countries add up. Omit to search everywhere — the `by_country` map of any result lists the exact values in use.
country.title: Country

keyword.description: Keywords matched as whole words (plural tolerated) in title, buyer or description, plus the cached translations of each keyword on the portals of that language — the way to search across countries without translating anything yourself. Several keywords widen the search (a notice matching any of them is returned).
keyword.title: Keyword

max_value.description: Maximum estimated value. Notices without a published value remain included.
max_value.title: Max Value

min_value.description: Minimum estimated value, in the currency of the notice. Notices without a published value remain included when this is set.
min_value.title: Min Value

page.description: 1-based page number, 1 to 3 on this free endpoint.
page.title: Page

q.description: Free text over title, buyer and description. Every word must match the *start* of a word in the notice ('nettoy' finds 'nettoyage'); a substring inside a word does not match. Accent- and case-insensitive.
q.title: Q

sort.description: 'newest' (publication descending, the default), 'oldest' (publication ascending) or 'deadline' (soonest submission deadline first).
sort.title: Sort
